text:
maria: Starting staged cutover for inference-service v3 -> v4 in eu-west. Automation hit pause at 60% traffic. Observed scheduling failures and helm hook errors. Looks like a node-label/subnet tag mismatch after last-night infra tweak. :eyes:
jonas: Can you paste the scheduler logs + the helm hook output? Is the rollout automation able to rollback automatically?
kevin: That was my change—I bumped the eu-west subnet to free up IPs, and I adjusted node-pool tagging to use `pool=shared` instead of `pool=inference`. I didn’t expect the gitops tags to be used in the helm charts. Sorry — on it.
maria: Scheduler error: `FailedScheduling: 0/12 nodes are available: Insufficient gpu` and helm preStop failed with nodeSelector mismatch. Pasting short excerpt:
```
I0312 03:21:14.123 kube-scheduler.go:123] "pod rejected" pod=inference-service-v4-7b6c FailedScheduling 0/12 nodes are available: Insufficient gpu
W0312 03:21:15.456 helm.go:87] preStop hook failed for release inference-service: nodeSelector requirement mismatch: expected {pool=inference} got {pool=shared}
```
olivia: Oof. That explains pods can't land on GPU nodes because labels changed. We should pause the staged traffic and fallback to v3 immediate while infra is fixed.
deploy-bot: ProgressiveDelivery: traffic-shift paused by jonas at 1894506830 :pause_button:
jonas: Paused. I'll open a quick terraform patch to restore `pool=inference` tag on the nodepool and remove the subnet tag change. Kevin, can you revert the ip allocation tweak in the eu-west workspace?
kevin: Reverting now. Pushing tf change to `infra-eu-west` workspace. My plan: restore nodepool tag + run `terraform apply -target=module.nodepool.tag` only.
maria: Meanwhile can we manual-rollback the helm release to v3 and re-point traffic? I want the site stable.
jonas: Yes — manual commands: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=3` and then `rdctl traffic-set inference-service --percent 100 --revision v3` (rdctl is our rollout CLI). Use caution: rdctl will try to reconcile with gitops, so set the gitops sync to manual temporarily.
olivia: I'll set the gitops repo to pause reconciliation for the namespace. Command we use: `flux suspend kustomization inference-prod`
sre-bot: Alert: GitOps reconciliation suspended by olivia. TTL 15m. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Terraform apply done, nodepool tag restored and nodes are re-provisioning with GPU labels. Expect nodes back in 2-5m.
maria: Once nodes are ready, we should re-run the rollout but with smaller step increments and a longer probe timeout. Suggest: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 10m stabilization windows. Also enable fallback routing to cpu-backed model variant for bursts.
jonas: Agreed. Update progressive-delivery policy in the rollout CRD: `steps: [10,30,60] stabilization: 600s fallback: cpu-variant` and keep automatic rollback enabled.
maria: After this incident let's add a terraform pre-deploy check that warns if nodepool tags used by helm/helmvalues would change. Maybe a small `tfplan` analyzer that scans k8s manifests in the gitops repo for label assumptions.
kevin: Good follow-up. I'll own a quick RFC for a preflight validation hook.
olivia: TL;DR: paused traffic, manual rollback to v3, tf revert applied, gitops suspended, nodes reprovisioning. Will resume staged cutover once nodes stable and policy adjusted. :thumbsup:
jonas: Thanks all. Postmortem to follow with timeline and the small automation patch. :memo:
